definitions.explanation: The specialized stage on which Noh theater is performed, featuring a roofed square platform and a bridge-like walkway for entrances.

examples.japanese: {能舞台|のうぶたい}で{演|えん}じる。
examples.english: To perform on a Noh stage.

examples.japanese: この{神社|じんじゃ}には{古|ふる}い{能舞台|のうぶたい}がある。
examples.english: This shrine has an old Noh stage.

examples.japanese: {能舞台|のうぶたい}は{屋根|やね}と{橋|はし}がかりを{備|そな}えた{独特|どくとく}の{構造|こうぞう}をしている。
examples.english: A Noh stage has a distinctive structure with a roof and a bridgeway.

notes:
The stage used for {能|のう} (Noh theater). Its standard features include a roof even when indoors, a square main platform, and the {橋|はし}がかり walkway by which performers enter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {能舞台|のうぶたい}に{立|た}つ: to stand on a Noh stage
- {能舞台|のうぶたい}で{舞|ま}う: to dance on a Noh stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {舞台|ぶたい}: stage — the general word for any performance stage
- {能面|のうめん}: Noh mask — another core element of Noh performance
